key_insight: ManiTwin automates conversion of a single image into a simulation-ready, semantically annotated 3D object twin, enabling generation of large-scale digital object datasets (100K+). This makes creating manipulation-ready assets fast and scalable.
problem_solved: Addresses the scarcity of data-generation-ready 3D assets for robotic manipulation by providing an automated, efficient pipeline that scales asset creation in both quantity and diversity.
method: Single-image to 3D reconstruction: infer geometry, texture, and topology from one input photo.
Semantic annotation and simulation optimization: automatically add part labels, collision meshes, physical properties, and bake textures for simulators.
Automated pipeline and quality control: batch processing, heuristics and validation to produce large volumes of consistent, manipulation-ready assets.
impact: Enables practitioners to generate vast, diverse simulation datasets quickly, accelerating training and evaluation of manipulation policies and reducing dependency on manual 3D modeling or costly real-world data collection.
visual_elements: Pipeline flowchart: single-image input → reconstruction → annotation → simulation-ready asset

paper_title: ManiTwin: Scaling Data-Generation-Ready Digital Object Dataset to 100K
paper_authors: Kaixuan Wang, Tianxing Chen, Jiawei Liu, Honghao Su, Shaolong Zhu
